text:
maria: Heads-up — CVE-2026-2013 in libkms-client (TLS key parsing) landed in OSS this morning. Using in hosted KMS proxy and Dedicated KMS client pkg. Public PoC posted.
kevin: ack. Link?
maria: https://security.example/cve-2026-2013 (internal tracker). PoC shows remote crash + potential key material exposure in a narrow window during rekey.
anika: Do we use the parsing code path on Private (on-prem) installs?
maria: Yes: hosted proxy, dedicated agents, and the on-prem package include the client. Private customers w/ KMS integration could be affected if they enabled auto-key-rotation.
sam: What's severity? CVSS 8.2? SLA impact if we patch?
maria: Vendor scored 8.2. Exploit seems feasible but requires crafted key exchange. Public PoC increases urgency.
kevin: Patch exists upstream; backported patch is trivial but touches our KMS client shim and audit fields. Risk: schema bump for audit logs (new field kex_meta).
hailey: Audit log schema bump could break older log parsers in some SIEM integrations for Enterprise customers. Need migration plan + opt-in flag.
anika: Proposed triage: 1) Hotfix for hosted (critical), 2) Scheduled patch for Dedicated with canary, 3) Coordinate Private patch windows with customers. Agree?
sam: +1. For hosted: we should do a rolling restart of KMS proxies with a canary (5% traffic) then 25/50/100. Keep token service read-only during canary?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: kms-proxy@v1.2.3-hotfix -> 5% traffic.
kevin: Capacity note: rolling restarts may briefly increase tail latency — expect ~200ms spike for affected requests. SLA hit risk low if we respect maintenance window, but agreed we should pre-announce to enterprise tiers.
maria: Who owns customer comms for Private/Dedicated? Need 48h notice for Dedicated customers on reserved capacity, and 7 days for on-prem with compliance change (audit schema).
hailey: I'll draft emails. For Dedicated: notify of maintenance window (2h) with expected degraded throughput but no key loss. For Private: propose staged patch doc + migration script for audit schema.
anika: Timeline suggestion: hosted hotfix deploy within 4 hours; Dedicated canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC (low traffic), full rollout 08:00 UTC; Private advisories sent today and patch ops next week after customer opt-ins.
esam: FYI we must update RBAC mapping in the client — new patch tightens key metadata access, default role required: kms-client:read_kex. That will break older service accounts that used wildcard. We need a fallback policy for 48h post-rollout.
maria: Good catch. Plan: include a compatibility toggle `ALLOW_LEGACY_RBAC=true` in the agent for 48 hours, log any uses to audit stream. Then flip off. Add migration steps to release notes.
kevin: Also: telemetry — add a metric `kms.kex.mismatch` to alert for legacy RBAC hits and PoC-like parameters.
hailey: Communication draft will mention the toggle and request customers to validate service accounts.
anika: Ops plan for hosted: run canary -> monitor `kms.kex.mismatch`, `proxy.error_rate`, `latency_p95` for 2h. If no regressions, proceed. Rollback plan: revert to previous image and run a coordinate rekey if needed.
maria: Who's on-call for the hosted canary in 4h? Kevin?
kevin: I'm on-call. I'll pair with Sam for rollback window.
sam: I'll prepare a smoke test script:```
# smoke test
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" https://kms-proxy/redwood/v1/keys | jq .status
# rekey flow
kmsctl rekey --key-id test-key --rotate
```
kevin: Add a test for audit schema: `jq 'has("kex_meta")'` on log lines.
hailey: Email draft: "We plan a maintenance window for KMS client patch (CVE-2026-2013). Hosted will be patched ASAP; Dedicated customers will be scheduled; Private customers will receive advisory and migration scripts. There is a temporary compatibility toggle available for 48h." I'll post to #customer-notices after review.
maria: OK. Action items: 1) maria: open internal security advisory + update tracker 2) kevin/sam: hosted canary + smoke tests in 4h 3) anika: schedule Dedicated canary and ops runbook 4) hailey: customer comms + migration scripts 5) dev: add `kms.kex.mismatch` metric and audit logging flag.
kevin: I'll bump urgency to P1 for hosted patch.
hailey: Also recommend we prepare a short public FAQ in case customers ask about "key exposure" language. Keep it factual: patched and mitigated, no evidence of mass exploitation.
anika: Noted. Let's reconvene after canary + 2h monitoring.
sam: adding checklist to the runbook now.
maria: thanks everyone. Posting postmortem template link: https://go.redwood/sec/postmortem-template
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary reached 25% traffic -> monitoring.
kevin: initial metrics look clean. No `kex.mismatch` alerts. Continuing.
hailey: sent Dedicated notice to sales + CSMs. Private advisory drafted and sent to compliance leads.
maria: end-of-thread: proceed with schedule. We'll update tracker with final times. :white_check_mark:
